title: Proposal to Use Life Expectancy Factor of 83.5 Years When Calculating CPF Savings for Property Purchases
what_it_is: Proposal to Use Life Expectancy Factor of 83.5 Years When Calculating CPF Savings for Property Purchases

sections.label: Home for Life lease condition
sections.summary: The Home for Life condition requires the remaining lease to cover the youngest owner until at least age 95.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Under the current Home for Life condition, the remaining lease must cover the youngest owner till at least age 95.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: So, if we set the requirement at 83.5 years, many seniors would live longer than this average lifespan.

sections.label: Helping long-term HDB renters
sections.summary: Long-term HDB renters with good income fall a few years short of the 95-year lease requirement, and MND and HDB will review ways to help them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The second category are those who have been renting HDB flats for a long time and they have been making good income, working hard, trying to get out of the rental spiral.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: However, because of this 95-year-old requirement, they are a couple of years short of a lease tenure of a price that they will be able to afford to own their own HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And the two groups of residents that he spoke about, I think many of us would have encountered them in our constituencies too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, certainly I think the Ministry of National Development and HDB will take a look and see what are some of the appropriate ways that we can help these individuals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: But I would say that in helping them, we got to be also mindful that we are helping them not just to find a house for the immediate period, but also for a home that can last them for life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And that is why I think this safeguard of ensuring that the remaining lease can last them till at least age 95 is an important one.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: If there are other ways in which we can help them, I think we are open to reviewing and looking at different possibilities.
